test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All jacks are aces.

No ace is a king.

Some queens are kings.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some queens are jacks.

II. Some kings are jacks.

III. No jack is a king.

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follow.
Only conclusion I and II follow.

solution:
**Statements:**

All jacks are aces.

No ace is a king.

Some queens are kings.

**Possible Venn Diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79abf43dfb86f7bfc413bebd5559d7fb620a7a0ee71a73fba3c4ffb4155327b6.png] 

**Conclusions**

I. Some queens are jacks → False (Since all jacks are aces)

II. Some kings are jacks → False (Since all jacks are aces)

III. No jack is a king →** True** (Since all jacks are aces and no ace is a king)

Hence, **only conclusion III follows.**
